description: The community GTFS archives a phone downloads at runtime as a last-resort coverage source, the same on Android and on the iPhone: which archive, for which operator only, from which day, how it is asked (HTTPS on its own host, the time limits, the largest body, the redirects), how long a download is kept and how long a failure or a refusal pauses it, and the limits of the archive and of its tables. The realtime feed joined to each archive is in realtime-feeds-v1.json; the cases both platforms read are contracts/shared-rules/v1/remote-gtfs-v1.json.

feeds.note: Brussels and Amsterdam to Milan by night since 9 September 2026; a community mirror, never above RFI or an official GTFS.
